title: A deadline will be missed
summary: A decision-first response for surfacing slippage early, separating facts from assumptions and resetting commitments with a documented owner.
contentNotice: Demonstration playbook for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy and must be reviewed before operational use.
scenario: Use this when a committed internal or external milestone is no longer realistically achievable on the agreed date.
immediateAction: Confirm the earliest credible completion date and the specific dependency causing the change.
Notify the owner before the deadline passes; avoid waiting for perfect information.
Present the impact, the proposed revised date and one practical mitigation option.

whoToInform.when: As soon as slippage is credible rather than merely possible.
When launch, supplier commitments, public communication or material spend may change.

escalationConditions: The revised date affects a launch, customer-facing commitment or production slot.
More than one dependent milestone moves.
The cause is recurring or reveals a process/control failure.

templatesResources.label: Deadline change note
templatesResources.text: Original commitment → current fact → impact → revised date → mitigation → decision needed.
